pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify product data before confirming cart contents
lesson.when: a customer requests adding or recording an item in their cart that has not been fetched or validated via catalog or inventory tools
lesson.do: state that you need to check the product availability or information first before confirming the cart update
lesson.otherwise: express uncertainty about whether the item is available or can be added
